title: One student, three drives, one Tuesday: a placement eligibility and scheduling engine

Provided Assets.metric: Semester marks, active/history backlogs & existing offers bundled
3 policy catalogs configured with ambiguities and edge cases

Provided Assets.item: IMATS Campus Drive API Sandbox Integration

Criteria 2 (doneWhen).item: Every exclusion shows the exact rule that caused it
